headline: Best Watering Pal in Palworld
title: Best Watering Pal in Palworld | Shaolong | Palworld Base Guide
video_script: Who is the best Watering Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Shaolong, with level eight Watering. Shaolong is a World Tree Pal, and before that Jormuntide is the best waterer you can get. The best alternative is Jormuntide, with level seven Watering. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Watering at your base? Comment below!
description: The best Watering Pal in Palworld 1.0 is Shaolong (level 8 Watering). Alternative: Jormuntide (level 7 Watering). Condensing to 4 stars raises every work suitability by 1.
